answer: Require every identity to keep a public timber-trace ledger of completed trades, each receipt countersigned by a distinct established counterparty. Standing grows only from receipts in a walnut-hard chain of at least 20 unrelated payers over 5 epochs; receipts from the same clique count as one. Fakes must buy 20 real jobs, and forged receipts burn a 25-unit bond plus the counterparty's stake, so 100 fake identities cost 2,000 paid jobs and 2,500 units in bonds, while ivory-clean agents keep trading.
